Good to know

Questions,
answered.

The essentials behind USD Bloom, its yield and how it moves.

USD Bloom is designed to be backed by a diversified reserve of dollar-denominated stable assets and carefully managed on-chain positions. Reserve reporting keeps the composition visible.

Capital is allocated across selected DeFi lending and liquidity strategies. Risk controls limit exposure, while generated returns accrue to the token.

Bloomfi’s core smart contracts are designed for independent security review, with each major release assessed before it reaches the protocol.

Supported users can exchange USD Bloom for an equivalent value in eligible stable assets, subject to available liquidity and protocol terms.

Bloomfi is designed for a phased multi-chain rollout, beginning with established EVM networks and expanding as integrations complete their reviews.
